title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a hand computation at the bottom level of the Teichmüller tower: the genus-1 modular group with its real (orientation-reversing) structure.

**Setting.** Let Λ = Z e' ⊕ Z e'' be H_1 of the square torus R^2/Z^2. The figure shows the fundamental square a0 a1 a2 a3, the curved arrow for the quarter-turn rotation, and the two mirror axes.
- τ' is the reflection fixing the e'-axis ("τ' = cte"): τ'e' = e', τ'e'' = -e''.
- τ'' is the reflection fixing the e''-axis: τ''e' = -e', τ''e'' = e''.
- σ is the rotation by 90°: σe' = e'', σe'' = -e'. It is the automorphism of order 4 of the elliptic curve with j = 1728.

**Relations in GL2(Z).**
- τ'τ'' = τ''τ' = σ^{-2} = ω0 = -1, and σ^4 = ω0^2 = 1.
- τ' = σ^2 τ''.
- r0 := στ' = τ'σ^{-1} is the reflection in the diagonal, swapping e' and e''.
- σ^{-1}τ'' = τ''σ: conjugating by a reflection inverts the rotation.

**Transvections.**
- ε' (previously called ρ') is the transvection e' ↦ e', e'' ↦ e'' - e', i.e. the matrix [[1,-1],[0,1]]. It is the Dehn twist along e'.
- ε'' = σ ε' σ^{-1} is the transvection e' ↦ e' + e'', e'' ↦ e''.
- Grothendieck records the conjugation actions σ(ε') = ε'', and τ'(ε') = τ''(ε') = ε'^{-1}, likewise for ε''. All of these check out.

**Renaming.** He then renames: τ'' → τ_∞ = r_∞, σ → σ_∞, ε' → ε0, ε'' → ε1, στ' → r0. The indices 0, 1, ∞ indicate he is thinking of the cusps / special points of the modular line M_{1,1}, with real involutions r0 and r∞.

**Presentation of SL2(Z).** With ρ an element of order 6 satisfying ρ^3 = -1, he writes ε0 = σρ and ε1 = ρσ, so that ε1ε0 = ρσ^2ρ = -ρ^2 = ρ^{-1}. Hence:
- ρ = (ε1ε0)^{-1} = ε0^{-1}ε1^{-1};
- σ_∞ = ε0ρ^{-1} = ε0ε1ε0 = ρ^{-1}ε1 = ε1ε0ε1.

The last equality is the braid relation ε1ε0ε1 = ε0ε1ε0. He verifies it from the (σ, ρ) side:
- ρσ^2ρ^2σ = σρ^2σ^2ρ,
- which reduces to -ρ^3σ = -σρ^3, i.e. ρ^3 is central.

This is the classical presentation SL2(Z) = B3 / ⟨(ε0ε1)^6⟩, i.e. ⟨ε0, ε1 | braid relation, (ε0ε1)^6 = 1⟩.

**The real involution r0.** He computes its action on the generators:
- r0(ε0) = ε1^{-1} and r0(ε1) = ε0^{-1};
- hence r0(ρ) = ε1ε0 = ρ^{-1};
- and r0(σ) = ε1^{-1}ε0^{-1}ε1^{-1} = ε0^{-1}ε1^{-1}ε0^{-1}, the braid relation again.

So GL2(Z) = SL2(Z) ⋊ ⟨r0⟩ is presented by ε0, ε1, r0. The final line "ε0, ε1, r0" names this generating system.

**Lifts.** The tildes at the top (ρ̃', ρ̃'' = σ(ρ̃')) indicate the intended use: lifting these elements to a covering group (B3, or the mapping class group of the once-punctured torus). The purpose is to describe the extended (real) modular group as an automorphism group at level (1,1), for the Galois/complex-conjugation action on the Teichmüller tower.

**Context.** The neighbouring pages are unrelated administrative scrap paper used as notepaper.
errors: No substantive errors. I checked all the matrix identities, including στ' = τ'σ^{-1} (as written in the image), σ^{-1}τ'' = τ''σ, the conjugation formulas for ε', and the braid relation; all hold.
Minor point: ε1ε0 = -ρ^2 = ρ^{-1} uses ρ^3 = -1 implicitly. This is only justified a posteriori, by the line -ρ^3σ = -σρ^3 together with the standard fact that ρ has order 6.

ideas.what: GL2(Z) acting on H_1 of the square torus, generated by the rotation σ (order 4) and the reflections τ', τ''; ω0 = -1 = σ^2.
ideas.modern_name: Extended modular group GL2(Z) as the extended mapping class group of the torus
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the Teichmüller tower and its low-dimensional generators, but not this explicit computation.

ideas.what: SL2(Z) generated by two transvections (Dehn twists) ε0, ε1 satisfying the braid relation; ρ = (ε1ε0)^{-1} of order 6 and σ = ε0ε1ε0 of order 4.
ideas.modern_name: SL2(Z) ≅ B3/⟨(σ1σ2)^6⟩; mapping class group of the torus generated by Dehn twists
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions the genus-1 level of the tower; not explicitly this.

ideas.what: Action of the orientation-reversing involution r0 (reflection in the diagonal) on the generators: ε0 ↦ ε1^{-1}, ε1 ↦ ε0^{-1}, ρ ↦ ρ^{-1}.
ideas.modern_name: Complex conjugation / real structure acting on π1(M_{1,1}); semidirect product GL2(Z) = SL2(Z) ⋊ Z/2
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical; in the GT context, the extended GT group and complex-conjugation action (Drinfeld; Ihara; Lochak–Schneps)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine verification of the classical presentation of SL2(Z) and GL2(Z) by braid-related transvections and a reflection, worked out as groundwork for the genus-1 level of the Teichmüller tower with real structure. It is correct and standard; there is nothing new for a specialist.
transcription_corrections: Under the '||' below στ', the image reads τ'σ^{-1} (single prime), not τ''σ^{-1}. The single-prime reading is the mathematically correct one, since τ''σ^{-1} would send e' to -e''.
'σ τ' = τ'_∞ = r_0' is plausibly the intended reading; the subscripted symbol is hard to read.
